purpose: Test whether the reported B1 train/boat dynamics abnormality appears without a preceding scene or boundary; this is not a mechanism experiment.
commit_policy: Native-State Invalidation/Rebinding remains frozen at e556855; standalone runs use no experimental inference flag.
comparison: Each standalone B1 is compared with the first 45 RGB frames of the corresponding B1 region after the A2#B1 boundary in the existing Phase-5 native_state_rebinding artifact. A fresh one-scene 12-latent rollout decodes to 45 RGB frames, whereas later three-second windows in the six-scene decoded tensor span 48 RGB frames because the global decode omits its three-frame offset only once.

cases.prompt: A bright blue freight train alone crosses a snowy mountain viaduct at dawn, no people or passengers visible, cinematic wide shot.
cases.review_focus: B1-only result; train smoke-related dynamics are tested by the conditionally registered train_b2 control.

cases.prompt: A small white fishing boat alone crosses a dark green ocean beneath a cloudy sky, cinematic aerial wide shot, no people visible.
cases.review_focus: B1-only result; boat direction-change dynamics are tested by the conditionally registered boat_b2 control.

cases.prompt: The same bright blue freight train alone on the same snowy mountain viaduct, cinematic wide shot, slows as white steam rises.
cases.review_focus: Conditional exact-B2 standalone control triggered because smoke dynamics are not present in B1. The standalone prompt deliberately retains its original phase-5 wording, including 'same', as requested.

cases.prompt: The same small white fishing boat alone on the same dark green ocean, cinematic aerial wide shot, changes direction as waves roll behind it with no people visible.
cases.review_focus: Conditional exact-B2 standalone control triggered because direction-change dynamics are not present in B1. The standalone prompt deliberately retains its original phase-5 wording, including 'same', as requested.
